subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A', 'B' and 'C' to write 7 complete sentences.
stimulus: 1  7 = 7 Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) Jobs was i. began at the hands i. he found no interest there (b) He was brought up ii. observed him very closely and gave ii. teach the students in his (c) Jobs’ education him a class (d) When he was admitted iii. an abandoned iii. in the class (e) He had learned iv. a disturbing element iv. workbook with problems (f) So, he became v. and educated by a car mechanic v. child (g) Once his teacher vi. all things earlier than the teacher vi. of his mother Imogene Hill used to vii Paul Jobs and his wife Clara vii. in an elementary school
guide_solution: Matching (a) Jobs was an abandoned child. (b) He was brought up and educated by a car mechanic Paul Jobs and his wife Clara. (c) Jobs’ education began at the hands of his mother. (d) When he was admitted in an elementary school, he found no interest there. (e) He had learned all things earlier than the teacher used to teach the students in his class. (f) So, he became a disturbing element in the class. (g) Once his teacher Imogene Hill observed him very closely and gave him a workbook with problems.
